_comment: Mock verdicts para demo offline do orquestrador (Sprint 1 Phase B). MockLlmClient faz match por symbol_fqn quando candidate_id não bate exatamente. Adicione novos verdicts ao expandir a Golden Suite. Fonte: ADR 0002 §10 + fixtures/the-sinner.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: Threshold check could be argued as input validation enforcing a database constraint
defenses_considered.assessment: Rejected. Code mutates Order.Total via 0.90/0.95/0.98 multipliers based on business tiers; this is pricing policy, not validation.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: Loyalty discount could be a denormalization step legitimate for ORM
defenses_considered.assessment: Rejected. Discount is computed imperatively from tiered thresholds, not projected from already-computed domain state.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: CustomerName null check could be database NOT NULL pre-check
defenses_considered.assessment: Partially valid for that line, but does not redeem the discount logic that precedes it.

rejection_reasons: Method branches on Order.Total against business thresholds (1000, 500, 100) and applies tiered discount multipliers (0.90, 0.95, 0.98) before persisting; this is pricing policy, a domain concern.
Mutation of Order.Total prior to _store assignment couples the persistence boundary to business rules that belong in the Order aggregate or a PricingService.
Sinner.Infrastructure.OrderRepository.Sa.evidence_quote: Method 'SaveAsync' applies threshold-based loyalty discount logic (10% above 1000, 5% above 500, 2% above 100) prior to persistence, coupling the repository to domain pricing rules.

Sinner.Infrastructure.MegaRepository.DoE._note: Este candidato NÃO deveria chegar ao LLM em produção — LNTY-009 aborta antes (slice excede 8K tokens). Mock retorna NO_VIOLATION caso o orquestrador receba indevidamente, garantindo que o motor nunca dependa de o LLM 'cobrir' a falha de gating.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: Method exceeds analyzability budget; should have been caught by LNTY-009 before reaching LLM
defenses_considered.assessment: Sustained. Per Lintty pipeline (04-llm-ops.md §9), oversized slices abort with LNTY-009 and are never sent to LLM. If this candidate arrived here, it is a pipeline bug, not a LNTY-004 violation.

Sinner.Infrastructure.MegaRepository.DoE.evidence_quote: Method exceeds Lintty's semantic analyzability budget; verdict deferred to LNTY-009. No LNTY-004 evaluation performed.

Saint.Infrastructure.OrderRepository.Sav._note: Saint não dispara pré-filtro Roslyn LNTY-004 (cyclomatic <= 3, no branching). Este verdict só serve se um futuro fixture Saint adicionar candidato calibrado.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: Method is pure persistence: Add + SaveChangesAsync, no branching, no comparisons
defenses_considered.assessment: Sustained. Method delegates entirely to EF Core primitives; no domain logic present.

Saint.Infrastructure.OrderRepository.Sav.evidence_quote: Method 'SaveAsync' delegates to DbSet.Add and DbContext.SaveChangesAsync without business branching or computation. Pure persistence.

by_candidate_id._comment: Quando o backend-dev-dotnet em Phase B fixar os candidate_ids estáveis (sha256 sobre rule_id|file|symbol_fqn|canon_version|code_slice_normalized), copiar aqui o ID e o verdict correspondente para garantir match determinístico. Por enquanto, by_symbol_fqn é o caminho default.

defenses_considered.defense_summary: Mock client has no canned verdict for this candidate; default to NO_VIOLATION to avoid false positives in demo
defenses_considered.assessment: Sustained as conservative default. Demo path expects only known candidates from fixtures Saint/Sinner/Ninja-01.

default_when_no_match.evidence_quote: No mock verdict registered for this candidate; conservative NO_VIOLATION applied. Production AnthropicLlmClient would emit a real verdict.
